verdict.rationale: mParticle's docs reference a 'Real-time API to drive user personalization' (mparticle-docs-4) and IDSync framework for unified identity resolution (mparticle-docs-x1), suggesting a documented profile-lookup API/store for traits and identifiers exists. However, the evidence pack lacks explicit API reference docs (endpoints, schema, example queries) confirming full read access to event history, traits, and identifiers in one call, and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of its use for this purpose. missing for 10: explicit Profile API reference documentation with endpoint/schema details, example queries retrieving traits+identifiers+event history together, and independent developer corroboration.
